segments.content:
Reigniting the Verdant Era Chapter 135: Making a Big Move in Front of Xixi

The sports field of First Affiliated High was located to the west of the academic building.

After entering the sports field from the entrance on the right side of Houde Road, the flagpole for the flag-raising ceremony was on the left. Across the field was the main rostrum for the sports meet's opening ceremony.

On both sides of the rostrum, tiered, open-air bleachers stretched out—the place where students watched the events during the sports meet.

After the opening ceremony, following the host's guidance and the student council members' arrangements, each class sat down in their designated areas.

Class Eight of the first year was seated on the east side of the rostrum, in a spot about one-third of the way from the edge.

After the rock club's performance ended, Li Luo, as a member of the student council, had to put on his staff ID and run off to maintain order and such.

So after parting ways backstage, Yan Zhusheng tied her high ponytail back up and followed Xie Shuchen and the others away, heading toward the first-year section.

And when Yan Zhusheng's figure appeared in the stands, every section she walked past seemed to be frozen in time, with everyone staring at her.

Only after Yan Zhusheng had passed did everyone begin to whisper to the person next to them, asking if this girl was the lead singer of the rock club from just now.

If watching the rock club perform on the grass field earlier made people think it was a case of distance creating beauty, thus feeling that Yan Zhusheng was very pretty...

Then now, seeing Yan Zhusheng's face up close, everyone discovered that Yan Zhusheng at this distance seemed to be even more beautiful.

That exquisite face was simply beautiful from every angle, with no flaws.

Many of the boys' minds were filled with some unrealistic fantasies, which then led to a question.

If a girl like this truly fell for you, what side of herself would she reveal?

"Zhusheng is back!"

"You were so cool on stage just now!"

"Wuhu, awesome!"

Over at Class Eight, when they saw Yan Zhusheng walk over, a burst of enthusiastic applause erupted, led by Xu Yinghuan, Zhang Guohuang, and the others.

Students from several nearby classes looked over at the sound, their faces showing envy.

Yan Zhusheng blinked, whispered a "thank you," and was then pulled over by Xu Yinghuan to sit beside her.

She thought for a moment in her seat, then took off her school uniform jacket and saved an empty spot next to her for Li Luo.

At this moment, Zhu Yufei, holding the sports meet registration form, shouted toward the stands, "The preliminaries for the girls' 100-meter dash are about to start! Yan Zhusheng, Xu Yinghuan, you two can go to the gymnasium to report."

"OK, OK!" Xu Yinghuan jumped up from her seat and grabbed Yan Zhusheng's hand, "Let's go, Zhusheng."

"Mhm." Yan Zhusheng nodded, stood up to follow Xu Yinghuan, and the two walked down from the stands, rushing toward the gymnasium.

"You played pretty well." At the entrance of the gymnasium, Xu Youyu, who was patrolling and inspecting the area, smiled and said to Li Luo as he walked in.

"I was just the green leaf that made the red flower stand out." Li Luo smiled. "Zhusheng is the really amazing one."

"Don't sell yourself short." Xu Youyu patted him on the shoulder, then said, "You're in charge of guiding the teams for the first-year girls' 100-meter preliminary race at eight-thirty. Hurry up and get to it."

"Roger that, Mr. President."

After bidding farewell to Xu Youyu at the gymnasium entrance, Li Luo walked into the building and went over to the PE teacher.

Before long, the girls from each class participating in the 100-meter race gradually arrived to gather.

Ying Chanxi, still wearing her staff ID around her neck, was among the first to arrive.

She spotted Li Luo at a glance, walked up to him, took off her own staff ID, and hung it around Li Luo's neck. "Hold on to this for me."

"Good luck in a bit," Li Luo said with a smile.

"I'm not from your class," Ying Chanxi huffed. "If I get a good ranking, I'll beat your class's score."

"It's a sports meet, so having fun is the most important thing. As for class points, we'll just let fate decide."

According to the scoring standard of First Affiliated High's sports meet, the top eight finishers in each event could earn a certain number of points for their class.

First place was 10 points, while second place onwards would get 7, 6, 5, all the way down to 1 point.

However, even if a class won first place in the year-level rankings, it was just a certificate and a rank. It was, at best, a way to boost class cohesion.

This kind of thing probably wasn't even tied to the head teacher's bonus.

"Huh, Xixi is here too."

Before long, a familiar voice came from the side.

Xu Yinghuan threw her arms around Ying Chanxi's, saying affectionately, "Go easy on me later, okay?"

"Huanhuan, you're running the 100-meter too?" Ying Chanxi blinked. Although she said this, her eyes were looking at Yan Zhusheng behind Xu Yinghuan. "Zhusheng is here too."

"Mhm." Yan Zhusheng nodded, walked straight up to Li Luo, took a harmonica out of her pants pocket, and stuffed it into Li Luo's hands. "Hold this for me."

"Oh." Li Luo nodded and put the harmonica in his own pocket.

Off to the side, Ying Chanxi saw their little exchange and asked, pretending to be curious, "Zhusheng, what did you just hand over?"

"A harmonica, from Li Luo," Yan Zhusheng said honestly.

"Oh..." Ying Chanxi chuckled, then looked at Li Luo. "It's the one you bought before, right? You were being all secretive and wouldn't let me see it."

"Didn't I also buy a camera for you?" Li Luo said, looking exasperated. "Where's your camera?"

"I asked Xinyan to hold it for me." Ying Chanxi shot him a look. "I'm here to compete, I can't possibly carry it around."

While they were chatting, the other competitors had almost all arrived, so the PE teacher began to call out names from a list.

"Ying Chanxi."

"Xu Yinghuan."

"Zhang Yuanying."

"You eight are in one group." After calling out eight names, the PE teacher then said to Li Luo, who was beside him, "You can lead them onto the field first."

For the girls' 100-meter preliminaries, there were a total of 32 competitors from the first year. They were divided into groups of eight for the preliminary heats, and the top eight with the fastest times would advance to the finals.

Li Luo was responsible for guiding the first group. After Ying Chanxi and the others were lined up, he led the group out of the gymnasium, all the way to the 100-meter track, where he coordinated the list with the teacher in charge there.

And the first-year classes happened to be in the east stands, which were closest to the 100-meter starting line.

When the people from Class One saw Ying Chanxi, they all got a little restless.

Xie Shuchen and Liu Shaowen even stood right up against the railing of the stands.

Class Eight was a little farther away, but they could still make out Xu Yinghuan.

Xu Yinghuan usually had a cheerful and enthusiastic personality and was very popular in class. Everyone was getting ready to cheer for her, but they were still relatively reserved.

Only that clown Zhang Guohuang was shameless enough to shout directly, "Xu Yinghuan! Get first in the group! I'll cover your lunch!"

"Get lost, you!" Xu Yinghuan raised her fist and waved it at Zhang Guohuang, laughing as she scolded him.

The teacher in charge waved the small flag in his hand, signaled to the teacher at the finish line, and then arranged for Ying Chanxi and the others to enter the track.

At this time, the girls from the second group were also led over by a student council member.

Yan Zhusheng walked to Li Luo's side, took the harmonica from his pocket, and went to the side of the track to cheer for Ying Chanxi.

"Go, Xixi."

"Mhm, thanks, Zhusheng." Ying Chanxi smiled. Then she watched as Yan Zhusheng put the harmonica to her lips and gently played a pleasant melody.

Hmm... why does it sound a little familiar.

Ying Chanxi was still a little nervous about the race at this moment, so she couldn't immediately recognize which song it was, but she felt like it was something she had heard recently.

But just then, the teacher was already telling them to take their positions.

Yan Zhusheng also stopped playing at the right moment and stuffed the harmonica back into Li Luo's pocket.

The next second.

"On your marks, get set... go!"

The starting pistol fired.

Ying Chanxi and the others sprinted out, racing toward the finish line.

As she crossed the finish line, a flash of insight suddenly went through Ying Chanxi's mind, and she remembered something.

The song Yan Zhusheng had just played, and the one Li Luo had sung to her over the weekend, "Chasing the Light."

They sounded so similar...

(End of this chapter)
